policy: Use the smallest useful set. Execution and trust are separate. External indexed sources are discovery-only until separately evidenced.

entries.name: ChatGPT Apps Deployer
entries.summary: Builds a deterministic release manifest for a ChatGPT app project without implying platform approval.
known_gaps: Does not submit or approve an app in ChatGPT; deployment remains a separate platform action.

entries.name: Codex PR Reviewer
entries.summary: Builds a deterministic review prompt from versioned business rules and severities.
known_gaps: Does not itself fetch or review a pull request; Codex or another review surface performs that step.

entries.name: CS Navigator
entries.summary: Turns a plain-language job into the smallest evidence-backed ChatGPT Skills recommendation using a versioned local catalog snapshot.
known_gaps: End-to-end recommendation behavior inside a qualifying ChatGPT Skills surface has not yet been promoted from designed to tested.
The bundled snapshot is intentionally finite and can report a coverage gap when a job is not represented.

entries.name: OpenAI Agents SDK Builder
